deleteDrawer.message: Once you have deleted the Outing, it will no longer be joinable by any invitees. Deleting this Outing will not affect your flake rating. This action is permanent.

leaveDrawer.message: Once you leave the Outing, it may still be completed by the other members. If it is, you will negatively affect your flake rating. This action is permanent (you cannot re-join after leaving).

joinDrawer.pendingLimit: It counts toward your limit of 5 pending Outings.
joinDrawer.mustComplete: It has to be completed (or deleted while you're the only member).
joinDrawer.leavingLowersRating: Leaving after you join lowers your flake rating.

completeDrawer.lastMember: You're the last member to mark it completed
completeDrawer.lockedYou: Once you mark it completed, the Outing is locked: no more changes to its media.
completeDrawer.lockedEveryone: Once every member marks it completed, the Outing is locked: no more changes to its media.
completeDrawer.chatStaysOpen: The Outing chat stays open so you can keep in touch.

rating.title: Rate the activity
rating.hint: Tap a star to rate it

completion.needMembers: Outing must have 2+ members to be marked completed.
completion.count: {{completed}} / {{total}} Members have marked this Outing completed.

howToComplete.intro: An Outing needs at least 2 members before it can be completed.

waitForInvites.one: Wait for your invite to be accepted, or invite someone else.
waitForInvites.other: Wait for your {{count}} invites to be accepted, or invite someone else.

howToComplete.inviteSomeone: Invite a friend or a Daily Match to join.
howToComplete.uploadPhoto: Add at least one photo or video from it.

photos.limitHint: Each member can add up to 2 photos or videos (videos 10 seconds max).

tooManyPhotos.message: Each Outing member can add up to 2 photos or videos. Remove one of yours to add something else.

noPhotos.message: Outings need at least one photo or video before they can be marked completed. You can add some on the Outing page with the button shown below:
noPhotos.allMembers: All Outing members must mark the Outing completed!

countdown.finishNote: {{time}} left for everyone to mark it completed. Anyone who hasn't by then is removed and gets a flake.
countdown.inviteNote: If no one joins within {{time}}, this Outing is deleted for inactivity.
countdown.invitesExpire: Invites expire in {{time}} if they haven't been accepted.

deleteHelp.onlyMember: You can delete the outing because you are the only member. Deleting the outing will not negatively affect your flake rating.
deleteHelp.otherMembers: You cannot delete the outing because there are other members. Leaving the outing will negatively affect your flake rating.

tooBig.message: That video is too large to upload. Try a shorter or smaller clip.

tooLong.message: Videos can be {{seconds}} seconds at most. Trim it and try again.

failed.message: The video didn't upload. Check your connection and try again.
